crossRefs.note: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than…

translations.web: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
translations.bsb: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
translations.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
translations.asv: He that speaketh in a tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
